page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 96 dedicated physical cores utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each core operates as a dedicated physical unit without hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include bundled local storage or GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. Because local storage is absent, storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. The qualitative cost profile of this instance reflects its high-density memory allocation and dedicated compute resources, positioning it as a specialized option for memory-bound workloads.

The ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity and dedicated single-threaded core performance. Suitable applications include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and memory-intensive analytics workloads.
